activity.notes: Kondiaronk was a Tionontati/Petun Huron (Wendat) chief at Michilimackinac. His documented political career is especially clear from 1687 through his death during the Great Peace of Montreal negotiations on 2 August 1701. ATLAS uses active_in rather than inventing a formal accession date for his chieftainship.

sources.title: KONDIARONK — Dictionary of Canadian Biography
sources.citation_text: The Dictionary of Canadian Biography identifies Kondiaronk as a Tionontati/Petun Huron chief at Michilimackinac, documents his political and military actions from 1687 onward, and his central role in the 1701 Montreal peace negotiations.
